name: Losing Control
source: You are a young man, languished by boredom. You get the chance to go on an adventure, a spontaneous journey, together with some beautiful ladies. Things were going well... But then everything went to hell.​
translation: 你是一个因无聊而疲惫不堪的年轻人。你有机会和一些美丽的女士一起去冒险，一次自发的旅行。事情进展顺利……但后来一切都变得糟糕了。​
